meeting_requirements.label: Notice & Agenda
meeting_requirements.question: Was notice appropriate to every matter and was the agenda fixed before deliberation?

meeting_requirements.label: Attendance
meeting_requirements.question: Which governing Partners were present, absent, or present for only part of the meeting?

meeting_requirements.label: Quorum
meeting_requirements.question: Which resolved constitutional rule establishes that the meeting may transact business?

meeting_requirements.label: Conflicts
meeting_requirements.question: Did each participant disclose conflicts and related-party interests before deliberation?

meeting_requirements.label: Recusals
meeting_requirements.question: Who was excluded from deliberation or voting on a specific agenda item, and why?

meeting_requirements.label: Votes
meeting_requirements.question: Did every vote, opposition, and abstention remain attributable to one eligible Partner?

meeting_requirements.label: Outcome
meeting_requirements.question: Does the recorded outcome follow the applicable resolved threshold without treating silence as consent?

meeting_requirements.label: Deadlock
meeting_requirements.question: If no outcome can be reached, which expressly adopted mechanism governs next steps?

meeting_requirements.label: Evidence
meeting_requirements.question: Which durable records prove notice, attendance, disclosure, votes, and outcome?
